name: SD10-a-mark-twice
old:
for (const m of SD_COLLAPSE_WARN_MS) if (left <= m) due = m;
  return due < said ? due : null;
new:
for (const m of SD_COLLAPSE_WARN_MS) if (left <= m) due = m;
  return due <= said ? due : null;

name: SD10-a-passed-mark
old: for (const m of SD_COLLAPSE_WARN_MS) if (left <= m) due = m;
new: for (const m of SD_COLLAPSE_WARN_MS) if (left < m + 5000) due = m;

name: SD10-said-when-out
old:
if (!(left > 0)) return null;
  let due = SD_COLLAPSE_MS;

name: SD10-the-way-home-unsaid
old: `The Hour collapses in ${t}. The way home opens where the Remnant fell.`

name: SD10-never-told
old: if (due != null) { const first = warned.s !== rec.s; warned = { s: rec.s, at: due }; warn(sdCollapseLine(left, { hour: inHour(), first })); }
new: if (due != null) { const first = warned.s !== rec.s; warned = { s: rec.s, at: due }; }

name: SD10-the-returns-words-in-the-hour
old: if (key === SD_RETURN_KEY && ret) return { title: retTitle, subs: [retTo] };
new: if (key === SD_RETURN_KEY && ret) return { title: SD_END_TEXT.ret, subs: [SD_END_TEXT.retTo] };

name: SD10-carried-off-where-it-rises
old:
ret = { ...standRet(at, yaw, scale ?? (rift?.hollow ? SD_HOME_SCALE : 1), ago < SD_HOME_RISE_MS), risesAt: now() - ago, pressed: true, up: false, lift: 0 };
      wasRet = null;
new: ret = { ...standRet(at, yaw, scale ?? (rift?.hollow ? SD_HOME_SCALE : 1), ago < SD_HOME_RISE_MS), risesAt: now() - ago, pressed: true, up: false, lift: 0 };
why: AUDIT SD II (SD11f, L6 F9): the way home is pressed alone, so no step into it is ever taken and the step latch's reset changes nothing a player can meet. It was the law that a player standing where it rose is not carried off; press-only keeps that law whole, and the reset stays for a Return stood this way that a later change lets be walked into again.

name: SD10-stood-before-the-body-sank
old: if (!s?.fell || sdFightLink.now() < s.fell.at + SD_REM_SINK_MS) return null;

name: SD10-out-with-no-veil
old:
gateVeil?.flash('hourHome');   // SD-LOOK: the way home's veil - its crack mended
    if (!modes?.unstuck?.()) return false;

name: SD10-the-readouts-unvoiced
old: warn: (text) => sdSay(text, SD_VOICE_RANK.readout),   // AUDIT SD II (SD11d): the readouts wait for the fight's turns and the floor's words
